news.title: Man injured in northwest Atlanta house fire, officials say
news.summary: A man is in the hospital with severe burn injuries after a fire on Saturday morning in northwest Atlanta, officials said.

news.title: 2 injured, family displaced after late-night fire at Clayton County home
news.summary: Two people were injured, and a family is displaced after a house fire erupted in Clayton County late Friday night, fire officials said.

news.title: Man dies in hit-and-run crash on interstate
news.summary: Atlanta police say officers are investigating a hit-and-run crash on the downtown connector that killed a man in the early morning hours of Saturday.

news.title: Man sentenced for 2024 fatal shooting inside Brookhaven tattoo shop
news.summary: A New York man was sentenced to life in prison after a DeKalb County jury convicted him in the fatal shooting inside a Brookhaven tattoo shop, district attorney officials announced.

news.title: Three arrested in $65K East Point apartment rent fraud scheme
news.summary: Three women are facing a battery of felony charges after a rent payment fraud scheme cost more than 60 East Point apartment tenants more than $65,000, according to police.

news.title: Police release video of ‘slowest PIT’ during Sandy Springs chase
news.summary: Sandy Springs police have released video showing a chase that ended with what they said was the city’s slowest PIT.

news.title: Police: 3 women arrested during rent fraud investigation in East Point
news.summary: Investigators found over 120 missing or fraudulent money orders involving more than 60 victims and over $65,000 in suspected losses at the Fulton Pointe Apartments.

news.title: 2 arrested in connection with burglary at beloved Reid’s Deli in Mableton
news.summary: Two men were arrested following an investigation into the Labor Day burglary of Reid’s Deli, a staple mom-and-pop business in Mableton, according to police.

news.title: Man accused of shooting ex-girlfriend with BB gun in Cobb County
news.summary: A woman is recovering after she says an ex-boyfriend allegedly shot her in the eye with a BB gun while she waited at her son's school bus stop.

news.title: 2 critically injured after fire at Gwinnett County home, officials say
news.summary: Two people are in critical condition following an early Friday morning house fire in Lawrenceville where firefighters pulled a trapped victim from a burning basement, according to officials.
